signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordSet: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.rules: At least 12 characters. Avoid common passwords.
setPassword.invalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
setPassword.missing: The link is incomplete. Open the full link from your email or administrator.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. If no email arrives, ask an administrator for a new link.

mfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
mfa.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
